entities.summary: Abu al-Abbas Iranshahri was a 9th-century Persian philosopher, mathematician, natural scientist, historian of religion, astronomer and author. According to traditional sources, he is the first figure in the wider Muslim world to be associated with philosophy after the advent of Islam. Iranshahri was a philosophers & thinkers from Nishapur (b. 900 CE, Nishapur). Recognized as a landmark figure with global significance (referenced in 0 Wikipedia editions).
